items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 15 October 2026 7:32am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 15 October 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Outbreaks of rain, turning persistent and at times heavy this morning, before clearing through early in the afternoon, leaving the rest of the day largely dry. Strong southwest winds at first, veering west and easing through the morning. Best temperature of 15°C.

Sunny spells and only a few passing showers tomorrow. Moderate to fresh west or northwest wind and a highest temperature of 13°C.


##Outlook##

High pressure then becoming established over the weekend leading to a prolonged spell of settled weather.
